ring_angels.name: The Ring of Angels
ring_angels.description: The Ring of Angels. Worn, it saves you when a hit leaves you below one fifth of your hitpoints, by carrying you to Ashvale. It rests for an hour between saves, or ten minutes once Iria has given you the Gift of Angels.

bones.name: Bones
bones.description: Bones, resource bones. Bury them for Prayer XP. From the valley of Ashvale.

big_bones.name: Big bones
big_bones.description: Big bones, resource bones. Bury them for Prayer XP. From the valley of Ashvale.

monk_robe.name: Monk's robe
monk_robe.description: A monk's robe of undyed wool, given by the chapel in Saltmere for the Wayside Prayer. Magic +1, Prayer +3. Adds a full second to each prayer point on top of any other Prayer bonus.
